content.json:
# SRE Agent Command Center

Central landing page for **agent-detected tenant health**, active incidents, recommendations, confidence, evidence, and automation state. Start your day here: triage the Top 10, confirm pending approvals, and follow drilldowns into the specialized workbooks.

> **SRE Agent at the center.** This page is an operating surface for both humans and the SRE Agent. Set the **Subscriptions** and **Log Analytics workspace** parameters, then act on the Top 10 recommendations below.

parameters.name: LogAnalyticsWorkspaceId
parameters.label: Log Analytics workspace
parameters.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces' | project value = id, label = name, selected = false | order by label asc

parameters.name: Environment
parameters.label: Environment
parameters.jsonData: [{"value": "All", "label": "All", "selected": true}, {"value": "Production", "label": "Production", "selected": false}, {"value": "Pre-Production", "label": "Pre-Production", "selected": false}, {"value": "Development", "label": "Development", "selected": false}, {"value": "Test", "label": "Test", "selected": false}, {"value": "Sandbox", "label": "Sandbox", "selected": false}]

parameters.name: BusinessCriticality
parameters.label: Business criticality
parameters.jsonData: [{"value": "All", "label": "All", "selected": true}, {"value": "Mission Critical", "label": "Mission Critical", "selected": false}, {"value": "Business Critical", "label": "Business Critical", "selected": false}, {"value": "High", "label": "High", "selected": false}, {"value": "Medium", "label": "Medium", "selected": false}, {"value": "Low", "label": "Low", "selected": false}]

parameters.name: Severity
parameters.label: Severity

content.json:
## Status at a glance

Tenant posture from live alerts, plus the agent's active recommendation load. Drill into the Top 10 and the sections below.

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend sev = tostring(properties.essentials.severity),
         cond = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition)
| where cond == 'Fired'
| summarize Crit = countif(sev in ('Sev0','Sev1')), Warn = countif(sev in ('Sev2','Sev3')), Total = count()
| extend Posture = case(Crit > 0, 'CRITICAL', Warn > 0, 'DEGRADED', Total > 0, 'ELEVATED', 'HEALTHY')
| project Posture, ['Active alerts'] = Total
content.title: Alert posture

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend sev = tostring(properties.essentials.severity),
         cond = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition)
| where cond == 'Fired'
| summarize Alerts = count() by Severity = sev
| order by Severity asc
content.title: Fired alerts by severity

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend sev = tostring(properties.essentials.severity),
         cond = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition)
| where cond == 'Fired'
| summarize Alerts = count() by Severity = sev
| order by Severity asc
content.title: Alert severity mix

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Status in ('New','Pending approval','Approved','In progress','Failed')
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| summarize Recommendations = count() by Severity
| order by Severity asc
content.title: Active agent recommendations by severity

content.json:
## Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

Prioritized, auditable actions the **SRE Agent** has produced for this page, ranked by `RecommendationScore`. Each row is evidence-backed and carries its agent action type, approval requirement, and lifecycle status.

- **Approval required = true** -> the agent will *not* act without human sign-off (always true for SLO, alert, remediation, health-model, access, or panel-deletion changes).
- Use the **Evidence / Incident / PR / Runbook** links to drill into the supporting data.
- Source table: `SREAgentRecommendations_CL`. If empty, no active recommendations exist for this page, or the workspace parameter is not yet set - see *Configuration* in the README.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where WorkbookName == "SRE Agent Command Center" and WorkbookPage == "Command Center"
| where Status in ("New","Pending approval","Approved","In progress","Failed")
| where isnull(ExpiresOn) or ExpiresOn > now()
| where "{Severity}" == "All" or "{Severity}" == "" or Severity == "{Severity}"
| where "{BusinessCriticality}" == "All" or "{BusinessCriticality}" == "" or BusinessCriticality == "{BusinessCriticality}"
| where "{OwnerTeam}" == "*" or "{OwnerTeam}" == "" or OwnerTeam =~ "{OwnerTeam}"
| where "{RecommendationStatus}" in ("Active","All","") or Status == "{RecommendationStatus}"
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| order by RecommendationScore desc, Severity asc, LastUpdated desc
| take 10
| project
    Rank,
    Severity,
    Recommendation = RecommendationText,
    Scope = AffectedScope,
    OwnerTeam,
    Confidence = ConfidenceScore,
    ['Agent action'] = AgentActionType,
    ['Approval required'] = ApprovalRequired,
    Status,
    ['Last updated'] = LastUpdated,
    Evidence = EvidenceLinks,
    Runbook = RelatedWorkItem,
    Incident = RelatedIncidentId,
    PR = RelatedPullRequest,
    RecommendationId
content.title: Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

content.json:
## Tenant health summary

Resource Health rollup across the selected subscriptions. **Unknown is not healthy** - treat Unknown/empty as risk and investigate telemetry coverage.

content.query:
healthresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/availabilitystatuses'
| extend state = tostring(properties.availabilityState)
| summarize Count = count() by state
| order by Count desc
content.title: Resource health state (tenant)

content.json:
## Agent health summary

Is the SRE Agent itself healthy and producing recommendations? Stale output (no rows in the last few hours) means the agent or its pipeline is degraded.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Recommendations = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by CreatedBy
| order by Recommendations desc
content.title: SRE Agent recommendation output (last 24h)

## Active incidents

Fired, non-closed Azure Monitor alerts grouped by severity. Click through to **Incident Triage & RCA** for correlated evidence and root-cause candidates.

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend sev = tostring(properties.essentials.severity),
         cond = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition),
         state = tostring(properties.essentials.alertState)
| where cond == 'Fired' and state != 'Closed'
| summarize Alerts = count() by sev
| order by sev asc
content.title: Active alerts by severity

content.json:
## Health state by management group / subscription / workload

Where is the risk concentrated? Resource and unhealthy counts per subscription highlight which scope to drill into.

content.query:
resources
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| summarize Resources = count() by Subscription
| order by Resources desc
content.title: Resources by subscription

content.query:
healthresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/availabilitystatuses'
| extend state = tostring(properties.availabilityState)
| where state in ('Unavailable','Degraded','Unknown')
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| summarize Count = count() by Subscription, state
| order by Count desc
content.title: Unhealthy / degraded resources by subscription

content.json:
## Critical alerts

Sev0/Sev1 alerts currently firing. These should map to a Top 10 recommendation or an open incident; if not, alert hygiene needs attention.

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend sev = tostring(properties.essentials.severity),
         cond = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition),
         name = tostring(properties.essentials.alertRule),
         target = tostring(properties.essentials.targetResource),
         fired = todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime)
| where cond == 'Fired' and sev in ('Sev0','Sev1')
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| project fired, sev, name, target, Subscription
| order by fired desc
| take 50
content.title: Critical (Sev0/Sev1) fired alerts

content.json:
## Service Health issues

Active Azure platform Service Health events (outages, advisories, planned maintenance) affecting the tenant. Platform issues should suppress auto-remediation.

content.query:
servicehealthresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/events'
| extend eventType = tostring(properties.EventType),
         status = tostring(properties.Status),
         eventTitle = tostring(properties.Title)
| where status =~ 'Active'
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| project eventType, eventTitle, Subscription
| take 50
content.title: Active Service Health events

content.json:
## Resource Health issues

Individual resources reporting Unavailable/Degraded right now - the concrete targets behind the rollup above.

content.query:
healthresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/availabilitystatuses'
| extend state = tostring(properties.availabilityState),
         summary = tostring(properties.summary)
| where state in ('Unavailable','Degraded')
| project resourceId = tostring(properties.targetResourceId), state, summary
| take 100
content.title: Unavailable / degraded resources

content.json:
## Agent confidence summary

Distribution of agent confidence on its active recommendations. Low average confidence in a category means more human review is warranted.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Status in ('New','Pending approval','Approved','In progress','Failed')
| summarize AvgConfidence = round(avg(ConfidenceScore), 2), Count = count() by Category
| order by Count desc
content.title: Average confidence by category

content.json:
## Pending approvals

Recommendations waiting on a human decision. Approving here authorizes the agent to act per its `AgentActionType`.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Status == 'Pending approval'
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| project LastUpdated, Severity, RecommendationText, AffectedScope, OwnerTeam, AgentActionType, RemediationRisk, RollbackAvailable
| order by LastUpdated desc
content.title: Recommendations pending approval

content.json:
## Automation actions - running / completed / failed

Execution state of agent-initiated automation. Failures and blocked actions feed the **Automation & Remediation** workbook.

content.query:
SREAgentActions_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by Outcome
| order by Count desc
content.title: Automation action outcomes

## Recent changes

Resource configuration changes in the window - a leading indicator for new incidents. Correlate spikes here with the incident timeline.

content.query:
resourcechanges
| extend changeType = tostring(properties.changeType),
         changeTime = todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp),
         target = tostring(properties.targetResourceId)
| project changeTime, changeType, target
| order by changeTime desc
| take 50
content.title: Recent resource changes

## Unknown health due to missing telemetry

Resources with **no diagnostic settings or stale heartbeat** report Unknown health. Unknown is a risk, not a pass - these drive coverage recommendations in **Observability Quality & Cost**.

content.query:
healthresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/availabilitystatuses'
| where tostring(properties.availabilityState) == 'Unknown'
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| summarize Unknown = count() by Subscription
| order by Unknown desc
content.title: Resources reporting Unknown health

content.json:
---
### Operating model (safe-update)
Live data on this page refreshes automatically. Changes to the **workbook definition** follow the suite's safe-update model:

| Change | How it happens |
| --- | --- |
| Live data refresh | Automatic |
| Low-risk metadata (titles, descriptions, layout) | Agent may auto-apply, versioned |
| Medium/high-risk panel or query changes | Pull request + human approval |
| SLO, alert, remediation, health-scoring, access scope, panel deletion | **Mandatory approval** - agent records a recommendation only |

Every change is versioned, validated, auditable, and reversible. See `docs/operating-model.md`.
